description: This is a PHP class defining a model for managing tax rate data within the OpenCart admin module. It contains methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve tax rate records, as well as manage their associations with customer groups. The class interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and to fetch tax rates filtered by various criteria.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling tax rate data operations within the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD operations and associations with customer groups.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Creates a new tax rate record in the database, possibly associating it with customer groups.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Updates an existing tax rate record and its associated customer groups.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Deletes a tax rate record and its associated customer group mappings.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific tax rate by its ID.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Fetches multiple tax rate records possibly filtered and sorted based on input data.

methods.name: getTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Retrieves all tax rates associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rate records.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rates within a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a tax rate with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a specific tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Removes all associations for a specific customer group across tax rates.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of customer group IDs associated with a particular tax rate.
